task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, try to go to the west. And then, make an attempt to move south. And then, try to venture west. That done, go to the north. And then, try to head north. Following that, ensure that the box is open. And then, recover the latchkey from the box within the workshop. Alright, thanks!
description:
You're now in the closet.



There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the west.

thought: I will first try to go west as instructed.
feedback:
You've just sauntered into a studio. You begin looking for stuff.

You scan the room for a coffer, and you find a coffer. Now why would someone leave that there?
